page.overview:
Who is Nsomeka?

Admiral Nsomeka was a 24th century Starfleet officer.

In 2367, Nsomeka informed Captain Jean-Luc Picard that a position had opened up in that year's class at Starfleet Academy, which had been granted to Wesley Crusher. She expected Crusher to report to the Academy within two weeks. ()
